name: Way
summary: Shopify store locator on Google Maps with no API key needed, priced by location count rather than by feature: the paid tiers add locations and nothing else, and it also works with Apple Maps and Mapbox.
best_for: retailers and brands with physical stockists who want a Google Maps locator on their Shopify storefront without setting up a Maps API key or paying Google directly — the app handles the key on every tier, including the free one, which removes the developer step
skip_if: you have one shop and do not mind the app's branding under your map, because the free tier already covers you; or you need routing, appointment booking or stock-by-location, since this maps and directs and does not do any of that
honest_knock:
The pricing page reads like a feature ladder and behaves like a counter. Basic, Advanced and Pro list the same eight capabilities, so the $8 and $23 steps above Basic buy nothing but a higher location limit, and the jump from 50 to 500 leaves no tier in between. A chain with 60 or 80 shops pays the 500-location price and uses a tenth of it.

The free plan is genuinely usable on a live store, which is worth saying plainly — the same developer's Blocky and TiXel listings advertise free plans that turn out to be development stores only, and this one is not that. What it does carry is the app's branding on your storefront and a hard limit of one location, so it is a real free tier for a single shop rather than a trial in disguise.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic Plan · per month for up to 50 store locations, or $67.10 a year
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-19) Four tiers, and above the first one the ladder is a location counter rather than a feature list. Free carries one store location, the floating Google Maps locator, appearance customisation and online support, with the app's own branding shown on your storefront. Basic is $6.99 a month or $67.10 a year and removes that branding, raising the limit to 50 locations and adding the map widget as an app block, a pop-up modal for multiple locations, full customisation with custom CSS, and bulk import and export. Advanced at $14.99 a month or $143.90 a year and Pro at $29.99 or $287.90 list exactly the same eight features as Basic; what they add is headroom, 500 locations and 2,000. Annual billing saves a stated 20% on every paid tier and each carries a 7-day free trial. No Google Maps API key is required on any plan. Charges are in USD and recur every 30 days. One line in the feature bullets sits against all of that: it advertises unlimited store locations, which no plan card offers. Developer Effective Apps, Ashdod, Israel; the app launched 24 April 2020, carries Shopify's Built for Shopify badge, names eleven interface languages and works with Google Maps, Apple Maps, Mapbox and Shopify's B2B solution. The review record read 134 at 4.7 on 19 September 2026, up one from 16 September: 118 five-star, 11 four-star, none at three, 3 at two and 2 at one.
